text:
maya: Heads-up — 5% canary for model-service (v2.14.0) is showing a slow tail and ~5% 502s on eu-west at 14:32 UTC. Heatcheck triggered. Can we call a stopcall?

deploy-bot: [deploy v2.14.0] canary rollout in progress -> 5% traffic (eu-west). rollout id: r-20250305-1748

alex: I can reproduce higher p50 on /generate for eu-west, not seeing it in us-west.

sarah: looking at logs: repeated kvcache eviction warnings and some OOM-ish traces around 14:29.

maya: Proposal: hold traffic and pin back to v2.13.7 for eu-west while infra + runtime investigate. Change window still open for ~40m. Quick thumbs?

ivy: +1 to hold. Please also confirm rollback-readiness checklist is good before pin. https://redwood.internal/ops/rollbacks 

alex: Rollback readiness quick list: 1) pin v2.13.7 routing, 2) confirm warmup on pinned nodes, 3) drain or cancel in-flight long requests, 4) update release notes + incident stub. I can do 1-3.

deploy-bot: Suggested command: `redwoodctl rollout pause r-20250305-1748` — use `--dry-run` first if you want to verify.

maya: @oncall-ops can you call the stopcall and authorize the pin if OK?

oncall-ops: Stopcall in effect. Holding traffic for eu-west now. :hand: All hands for remediation.

alex: Executing pin: `redwoodctl pin-service --service model-service --version v2.13.7 --region eu-west` — will post when propagation completes.

deploy-bot: Pin propagation: ✅ propagated to 3/3 edge clusters in eu-west. Traffic shifted to v2.13.7. rollout r-20250305-1748 paused.

sarah: Telemetry team, can you surface a 5m heatmap + error breakdown (client errors vs upstream vs infra) so we can scope regression?

ivy: I'm updating the release notes with a short note about the hold and the change window: "Canary held in eu-west; investigating elevated 502s; pin to v2.13.7 applied."

alex: Opening rollback ticket INC-4192 and attaching logs + kvcache traces. If infra finds model runtime regression, we'll keep pinned and cut a rollback.

maya: Plan: wait 10m for telemetry. If error rate drops <1% and latency returns to baseline we re-evaluate lifting the hold; otherwise keep pinned and escalate to runtime team. Will post update at +10. Thanks all. :pray:
